questions.year: What should I focus on this year?

errors.chart_changed: Your chart changed while this answer was being written, so it was discarded. Ask again to get an answer for the current chart.
errors.pin_changed: You changed the period while this answer was being written, so it was discarded. Ask again to get an answer for the new period.
errors.model_unavailable: The configured AI model isn't available on your endpoint. Pick a different model in Settings → AI.
errors.endpoint_unreachable: Couldn't reach your AI endpoint. Check that it's running and that the address in Settings → AI is correct.
errors.insufficient_credits: Your AI account is out of credits. Add credits with your provider (for OpenRouter: openrouter.ai → Credits), or pick a cheaper model in Settings → AI.
errors.auth_failed: Your AI key was rejected. Check that your OpenRouter key is pasted correctly in Settings → AI.
errors.rate_limited: The AI provider is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.reasoning_timeout: The model thought for over 3 minutes without starting its answer. Try again, or pick a faster model in Settings → AI.
errors.server_error: The AI provider is having trouble right now. Try again shortly.
errors.request_failed: The AI request failed — try again in a moment, or check your model and endpoint in Settings → AI.
errors.save_failed: This answer couldn't be saved on this device, so it may be gone after a reload.

not_configured.notice: Connect an AI model to ask questions about your chart — your chart itself is already calculated on your device.
